race.description: Thank You Port Pirie Motorcyle Club Pace
race.comment: SWEET NICKY (5) is the starting point despite being beaten just over eight metres after racing wide as an odds-on favourite at Globe Derby Park. Her Port Pirie win two back in NR up to 43 was decisive, beating Roll With Mustard by over 11 metres in a 1:57.6 mile rate, and she has already beaten HEATHBERN BRUCE in that form line. MY ULTIMATE BANJO (8) arrives off a winning performance, scoring by four and a half metres in a 1 LIFETIME WIN at Globe Derby Park, though the second-row draw asks him to do it differently. BROBENAH GIRL (4) has been beaten a nose at both latest runs, including when ahead of SWEET NICKY last start, and her Port Pirie track-and-distance record keeps her firmly in the argument. HEATHBERN BRUCE (2) was below his best last start but the head defeat two back in this grade and his edge over MANDS PEARL give him sound claims.
